name: Finance - Finance Overview Dashboard
description: Metabase dashboard tổng quan tài chính: doanh thu, chi phí, lợi nhuận

native.query: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) as total FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.finance_transactions WHERE type = 'CREDIT' AND transaction_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) as total FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.finance_transactions WHERE type = 'DEBIT' AND transaction_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)

SELECT date_trunc('month', transaction_date) as month, type, SUM(amount) as amount FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.finance_transactions WHERE transaction_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12 months' GROUP BY month, type ORDER BY month
SELECT category, SUM(amount) as total FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.finance_expense_requests WHERE status = 'APPROVED' AND created_at >= date_trunc('month', NOW()) GROUP BY category ORDER BY total DESC

cards.name: Yêu cầu chi phí đang chờ duyệt

native.query: SELECT id, requester_id, amount, category, reason as description, created_at FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.finance_expense_requests WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at DESC
